theorems.name: Submission.lip_approx_gm_graph_map_lipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ x z, ‖f x - f z‖ ≤ ‖x - z‖) → LipschitzWith (NNReal.sqrt 2) (fun x => q (graphPoint x (f x)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
